2607.16803.title: Explainable Lightweight Compact Deep Models for Speech Emotion Recognition
2607.16803.paper_summary: Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is an important component in a wide range of human-centered applications, including healthcare, customer service, and human-omputer interaction. In medical and decision-support settings, there is increasing interest in models that not only achieve accurate emotion recognition but also support transparent predictions and efficient deployment. However, many existing SER approaches rely on complex deep learning architectures that limit interpretability and increase computational cost. This paper presents an explainable and lightweight speech emotion recognition framework based on a compact convolutional neural network architecture. The proposed approach utilizes log-Mel spectrogram representations to capture spectro-temporal speech characteristics and employs attentive statistics pooling to emphasize emotionally salient temporal segments. To improve model transparency, gradient-based class activation mapping (Grad-CAM) is incorporated to visualize the time-frequency regions that influence the model's predictions. Experimental evaluation on the SAVEE emotional speech dataset demonstrates that the proposed framework achieves competitive recognition performance while maintaining a compact architecture with significantly fewer parameters than many existing SER models. The results indicate that efficient convolutional architectures combined with interpretable analysis can provide a practical balance between recognition accuracy, computational efficiency, and model transparency.
2607.16803.paper_summary_zh: 語音情感識別（SER）是許多人性化應用中的重要組成部分，包括醫療保健、客戶服務和人機互動。<lb/>在醫療和決策支持環境中，對於不僅能實現準確情感識別，還能支持透明預測和高效部署的模型，興趣日益增長。<lb/>然而，許多現有的SER方法依賴於複雜的深度學習架構，這限制了可解釋性並增加了計算成本。<lb/>本文提出了一種基於緊湊卷積神經網絡架構的可解釋且輕量級的語音情感識別框架。<lb/>所提出的方法利用對數梅爾頻譜圖表示來捕捉聲音的頻譜時域特徵，並採用注意力統計池化來強調情感上突出的時間段。<lb/>為了提高模型的透明度，本文結合了基於梯度的類別激活映射（Grad-CAM）來可視化影響模型預測的時間-頻率區域。<lb/>在SAVEE情感語音數據集上的實驗評估表明，所提出的框架在保持緊湊架構的同時，達到了具有競爭力的識別性能，且參數顯著少於許多現有的SER模型。<lb/>結果表明，高效的卷積架構結合可解釋的分析可以在識別準確性、計算效率和模型透明性之間提供實用的平衡。
